title: South Orchard
shortDescription: Low apple boughs shelter a well-used practice clearing.
longDescription:
Apple trees stand in friendly, crooked rows around a patch of springy grass. Fallen blossom collects along the paths, and last year's windfalls have become somebody else's breakfast.
Instructor Flint keeps watch over the Practice Dummy, whose straw hat has survived more lessons than anyone can explain. A Practice Sword, Practice Staff, and Practice Sling wait on the training rack. A practice rules board leans against the basket.

fixtures.name: Instructor Flint
fixtures.lookDescription: A scarred, long-eared hare in a worn leather jerkin, one ear notched, a nicked practice blade ready. Try talk flint.
fixtures.examineDescription: Flint's muzzle is greyed and one ear is notched from an old lesson gone wrong. The practice sword is nicked from years of demonstrations, not nursery play. She keeps the clearing open and the path to the Infirmary firmly in mind.
fixtures.dialogue: "Which weapon do you want to try? Type take Practice Sword, take Practice Staff, or take Practice Sling. Name it in full. Then type attack dummy. The dummy comes back after a lesson. If you mean to square up with a classmate standing in this orchard — the hare or mole or fox beside you, not a story-name — type duel and their given name. Both of you must agree."

ask.text: "Which weapon do you want to try? The sword, the staff, or the sling — they wait on the rack under the apple boughs, oiled and unromantic, while fallen blossom collects along the path. Type take Practice Sword, take Practice Staff, or take Practice Sling. A good fit steadies the paw. A poor fit feels unwieldy — we can talk about why. The dummy comes back after every lesson. A classmate standing with you is another matter: type duel and their given name, and wait until they agree."

fit.text: "Each species has one proficiency. Hare and fox like the sword. Badger and mole like the staff. Mouse and squirrel like the sling. A fit adds a little strength. A poor fit takes a little away."

choices.label: I will try a better fit.
I will keep what I have.

practice.text: "Type attack dummy to begin. During the lesson, attack continues. Ember still works here as practice. When your Field Primer inks a School leaf, cast that instead. Finish before you walk away. If you fall, you wake in the Infirmary, where Fen keeps clean linen and a pot of honey. If you mean to practice against a classmate standing with you, type duel and their given name. They must type duel accept. Do not invent a target who is not in the room."

misfit.text: "That weapon is a poor fit for your kind. It will feel unwieldy, and your strikes will be a little weaker. Talk with me, or try another from the rack."

switch.text: "Good. Type take Practice Sword, take Practice Staff, or take Practice Sling — the full name. If you type take weapon I will make you choose which one."

keep.text: "As you wish. Feet steady. Eyes open. Pride in your pocket. The apple trees will keep their crooked watch, and the dummy will still be here when you are ready to type attack dummy — or duel and a classmate's given name, if they are standing with you and they agree."

fixtures.name: Practice Rules
fixtures.examineDescription: 'Ask before borrowing equipment. Aim at the Practice Dummy, or type duel and a classmate's given name if both of you agree. Stop when someone needs help. A practice defeat sends you to the Infirmary.' Flint has added: 'Winning teaches one thing. Paying attention teaches several. You duel the Collegian standing beside you, not a name from a story.' Try talk flint for the practice commands.

fixtures.name: Fallen Apples
fixtures.lookDescription: A few sound windfalls rest in the grass. Type eat apple to restore health and focus.
fixtures.examineDescription: The apples are tart and honest. Eat one after a lesson. Type eat apple. The courtyard well is for drinking.
